name: lcalcpol-polarization-analysis
description: Parse LCALCPOL dipoles and compare matched-cell SOC minus noSOC raw polarizations before quantum reduction.

required: POSCAR used by the completed VASP calculation
OUTCAR from a successful, converged LCALCPOL/PEAD calculation containing complete p[ion] and p[elc] records

configuration.working_directory: Single mode reads POSCAR and OUTCAR from the current directory; compare mode requires explicit noSOC and SOC OUTCAR/POSCAR paths.

units_and_conventions.dipoles: p[ion], p[elc], and their sum in e Ang (e Angstrom)
units_and_conventions.polarization: dipole/volume multiplied by 16.021766, reported in C/m^2 and uC/m^2
units_and_conventions.branch_reduction: The dipole is solved in lattice coordinates and integer lattice quanta are subtracted componentwise.

assumptions: The OUTCAR is expected to be completed and contains complete p[ion] and p[elc] records; convergence is not inferred by this extension.
The single-structure result is a formal polarization branch, not by itself a spontaneous-polarization or switchability result.
Compare mode rejects mismatched POSCAR lattices and reports same-branch DeltaP as INSUFFICIENT without an adiabatic branch proof.

artifacts.format: Human-readable UTF-8 text in single mode; canonical JSON in compare mode
artifacts.content: Single mode reports ionic/electronic/total dipoles, raw/formal/branch-representative polarization and magnitudes. Compare mode reports both endpoints, hashes, polarization quantum vectors, candidate DeltaP, precision, assumptions, and an INSUFFICIENT same-branch conclusion when no path evidence is present. In v0.3.0 candidate DeltaP is reduced after raw subtraction; the old independently reduced endpoint difference is diagnostic only. JSON includes schema_version, reduction coefficients and integers, and C/m2/uC/m2 differences and reduced magnitudes.

stdout: Total dipole is labeled e Ang.
Raw polarization magnitude is labeled |P| in C/m^2.
Branch-reduced polarization magnitude is labeled |P_red| in C/m^2 and |P_red|*1e6 in uC/m^2.
The reduced magnitude is a formal-branch representative magnitude, not spontaneous polarization or a unique minimum.
Compare mode reports lattice mismatch as an error rather than comparing different cells.
failure_markers: FileNotFoundError/OSError for a missing or unreadable POSCAR or OUTCAR

authorization_policy.notes: No SSH, PBS, scheduler, remote service, remote read/write, or VASP execution is performed.

source_provenance.notes: Portable packaged source verification. Historical upstream paths/hashes are preserved in upstream_source_provenance; the packaged runtime may include the documented subsequent changes.

upstream_source_provenance.notes: Migration copy preserves the source POSCAR/OUTCAR parsing, constants, conversion, and reduce_branch algorithm, adds scientific-notation/last-record parsing and an explicit conservative compare mode. The original source file in Downloads was not modified; its source hash remains the provenance reference. The single-endpoint branch algorithm remains unchanged; compare-mode changes are described below. v0.3.0 changes compare-mode order to difference-first reduction in the shared noSOC quantum basis, preserving single-endpoint reduce_branch and the original conversion constant.
